physical_sensors_catalog.name: Electrocardiogram (ECG / EKG)
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: Detects cardiac dipole depolarization / repolarization potentials on skin surface (0.5 to 4 mV, 0.05–150 Hz).
spaceflight_problems: Electrode contact impedance changes (5 kΩ to 100 kΩ) due to sweating and microgravity fluid shifts.
Adhesive detachment during EVA suit donning/doffing and vigorous movement.
Triboelectric cable noise and electromagnetic interference (EMI) from suit life-support blowers mimicking cardiac arrhythmias.
engineering_solutions: Continuous electrode-contact impedance monitoring and lead-off flags.
Multi-lead cross-channel consistency checks (at least 2 independent leads).
Fluid-filled / capacitive electrodes with series current-limiting resistors (NASA Apollo bioinstrumentation heritage).
Motion-aware Signal Quality Indexing (SQI) fusing 3-axis accelerometer data.

physical_sensors_catalog.name: Photoplethysmography (PPG) / Pulse Oximeter
physical_sensors_catalog.type: Dual-Wavelength Optical Transducer (660 nm Red / 940 nm Infrared)
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: Beer-Lambert Law (I = I0 * 10^(-εcl)); calculates modulation ratio R = (AC/DC)red / (AC/DC)ir to estimate arterial blood oxygen saturation (SpO2).
spaceflight_problems: Severe peripheral vasoconstriction in extreme space temperatures (-120°C to +20°C) reduces peripheral perfusion.
Vigorous astronaut EVA motion corrupts optical path, causing false drops in SpO2 (e.g. 98% -> 64%).
Sensor displacement and ambient light interference.
engineering_solutions: Perfusion-Index (PI) aware quality gating: reject epochs where pulsatile AC waveform is below signal threshold.
Cross-sensor physiological divergence: SpO2 drop must be accompanied by compensatory heart rate and respiration rate surge, otherwise flagged as probe artifact.
Multi-site optical sensing (earlobe, forehead, and finger).

physical_sensors_catalog.name: Platinum Resistance Thermometer (RTD Pt100 / Pt1000)
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: Callendar-Van Dusen equation: R(T) = R0 * (1 + A*T + B*T^2) for positive temperatures.
spaceflight_problems: Thermal lag across suit layers during extreme orbital day/night transitions (+120°C to -125°C).
Discrepancy between skin temperature and core body temperature (skin can be cool while core is in hyperthermia).
Leadwire severance from suit mechanical articulation joints causing open-circuit reading (-999°C).
engineering_solutions: IEC 60751 precision Pt1000 RTD with calibrated bridge circuit.
Metabolic work-rate coupled thermal model: core temperature estimated from skin RTD, heart rate, and LCVG heat rejection.
Redundant dual-sensor deployment (in-ear auditory canal thermistor + suit core RTD).

physical_sensors_catalog.name: Vascular Doppler Ultrasound & Hemodynamic Monitor
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: High-frequency ultrasound (3.5–10 MHz) Doppler frequency shift measures blood flow velocity and vessel cross-sectional geometry.
spaceflight_problems: Microgravity cephalad fluid shift (1.5–2.0 L) causes internal jugular vein (IJV) distension (circular geometry, venous pressure 9–19 mmHg).
Venous blood flow stasis and retrograde flow, fulfilling Virchow's triad and leading to occlusive thrombosis (documented on ISS).
Operator-dependent; requires manual transducer placement and expert scanning.
engineering_solutions: Scheduled mission ultrasound protocol: Flight Days 30, 60, and 6 weeks pre-return (audited NASA standard).
Semi-continuous wearable hemodynamic proxies (thoracic bioimpedance and heart rate variability).
Autonomous Doppler velocity envelope processing to detect blood stasis without requiring immediate Earth review.

physical_sensors_catalog.name: Radiation Dosimeter Suite & Radioprotection
physical_sensors_catalog.type: Dual Detection: Superheated Tube Bubble Dosimeters & Silicon PIN Diodes
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: Radi-N2 Bubble Detector: Freon micro-droplets suspended in polymer gel vaporize upon neutron interaction, forming visible counting bubbles. Silicon PIN Diode: Ionizing radiation creates electron-hole pairs, measuring real-time dose rate (mSv/h).
spaceflight_problems: Galactic Cosmic Rays (GCR) and Solar Particle Events (SPE) deliver cumulative ionizing dose and acute flux (> 10 mSv/h).
Secondary neutrons generated inside spacecraft hull from cosmic ray collision.
Single-Event Upsets (SEU), Single-Event Latchup (SEL), and bit-flips in microcontroller registers.
engineering_solutions: Radi-N2 verified passive bubble dosimeters for zero-power, electromagnetic-immune neutron field mapping.
Active silicon dosimeter with Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) voting logic to filter single-event radiation spikes.
Automated EVA abort threshold (> 5 mSv/h acute rate commands immediate ingress to storm shelter).

physical_sensors_catalog.name: NDIR Micro-Capnometer (Breathing Gas / CO2)
physical_sensors_catalog.physics_principle: Infrared absorption at 4.26 μm wavelength specific to CO2 gas molecules.
spaceflight_problems: High ambient spacecraft CO2 (2.0–4.0 mmHg vs 0.3 mmHg on Earth) causing chronic mild hypercapnia, headaches, and cerebral vasodilation.
Moisture and saliva droplet condensation fogging optical windows inside suit helmet.
LiOH / amine CO2 scrubber exhaustion during prolonged EVA.
engineering_solutions: Heated optical window with hydrophobic coating to prevent condensation.
Dual-beam optical reference channel to eliminate zero-drift.
Continuous partial pressure monitoring with autonomous scrubber canister switch alert (> 12 mmHg).
